description: Threat model: an untrusted supplier delivers a possibly backdoored IDS model (MLP or 1D-CNN); the institution's model-intake screening gate (regime 1) runs Neural Cleanse and MM-BD with a clean holdout and clean reference models; after deployment, runtime monitoring (regime 2) runs STRIP and IBD-PSC on each flow. Conceptual; no data.
sources: article Section 2.1 (threat model and defender assumptions)
